2019年4月煤炭开采产排污系数手册初稿的第三方镜像；真实性未核
dataSetInformation.sourceCitation: Second National Pollution Source Census coefficient manual, chapter 06, coal mining and washing, April 2019 draft mirror indexed at https://eia543.com/archives/4996; official original and edition identity unverified.
dataSetInformation.sourceDescriptionOrComment: Historical source evidence only. The third-party April 2019 draft mirror has PDF SHA-256 bf0342869a978ec90473aef0247e8bfffc735a58713d0655f9901fc5fee0dcee. The target row is on PDF p.16 / printed p.15: bituminous and anthracite coal, surface mining, annual raw-coal output greater than or equal to 1.2 million t, high-water mining area. The output threshold selects the row; it is not measured site production. Per 1 t unwashed raw coal, its five original coefficients are industrial wastewater 1.8 t (check-only, not measured discharge), chemical oxygen demand generation 300 g, petroleum indicator generation 8 g, mercury generation 3.68 mg, and arsenic generation 11.2 mg. The row reports treatment efficiencies of 85% for physical COD treatment, 85% for chemical petroleum treatment, and 83% for chemical mercury and arsenic treatment. The conditional discharge formula is generation coefficient × (1 - efficiency × k) × (1 - r), where k is normal treatment operating days per year divided by normal enterprise production days per year, and r is the wastewater reuse fraction. Actual k and r are unknown. Former Process a87288f0-8b94-417d-9045-c752719172f2, version 00.01.005 at Git commit 2e163304adb9357cd7a17facfc8e5b426ed74a93, misrepresented this conditional source row as a mine-water treatment-plant life cycle inventory. It had no established reference treatment service, site production, energy or chemical inputs, residues, or verified exchange mapping; its 1000 kg Standard coal input confused the activity denominator with fuel, and its 1800 Waste water output referenced a missing Flow. That Process is retired from the active XML dataset; its original file remains in Git history. This Source is not a replacement Process, an approved site inventory, or a current coefficient. The official 2019 original and the relation of this draft mirror to the inherited “trial edition” label remain unverified; the official 2021 high-water row differs. Shared Source 08a0183e-84e8-456a-a7d4-83ea1ab0bacb is unchanged pending separate Data #35 review.

仅作历史来源证据。第三方2019年4月初稿镜像的PDF SHA-256为bf0342869a978ec90473aef0247e8bfffc735a58713d0655f9901fc5fee0dcee。目标行见PDF第16页／印刷第15页：烟煤和无烟煤露天开采、原煤年产量大于等于120万吨、高富水矿区。产量阈值只用于选行，并非现场实测产量。以每1吨未经洗选的原煤为分母，五项原始系数分别为工业废水量1.8吨（仅供校核，不是实测排放）、化学需氧量产生量300克、石油类产生量8克、汞产生量3.68毫克、砷产生量11.2毫克。该行记载的治理效率分别为化学需氧量物理法85%、石油类化学法85%、汞和砷化学法83%。条件性排放计算式为产生系数×（1－治理效率×k）×（1－r）；k为治理设施正常运行天数（天/年）与企业正常生产天数（天/年）之比，r为废水回用率。现场实际k和r均未知。原Process a87288f0-8b94-417d-9045-c752719172f2在Git提交2e163304adb9357cd7a17facfc8e5b426ed74a93中的版本为00.01.005，误将这一条件性系数行表示成矿井水处理站生命周期清单；它缺乏已确立的参考处理服务量、现场产量、能源和药剂投入、残余物以及经过核验的交换映射。原1000千克标准煤输入误把活动分母当作燃料，原1800废水输出引用了缺失的Flow。该Process已从活跃XML数据集中撤出，原始文件保留在Git历史中。本Source不是替代Process、获批准的现场清单或现行系数。2019年官方原件及此初稿镜像与旧称“试用版”的关系尚未核实；2021年官方版高富水目标行的系数不同。共享Source 08a0183e-84e8-456a-a7d4-83ea1ab0bacb保持原样，待Data #35另行审查。
